text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=hosted-inference-us-west-2, severity=high. Alert summary: sustained p95 latency > 2s and 5xx rate spike. Incident ID: INC-2026-0421-01
PagerDuty: Alert routed to primary on-call Alex C (rotation: infra-oncall). No ACK received within 90s, escalating to secondary Mira S.
Alex C: on it, waking up. grabbing logs + flamegraph.
Mira S: seeing the escalation — ACKing now. I'm remote but reachable.
Priya N: manager ping — what's the customer impact? Any paid customers in the affected shard?
Emily K: support: yes, we have 3 active customers in us-west-2 with high throughput, one reported timeouts ~3m ago. Opening a support ticket and notifying acct team.
Tony R: quick note — I noticed a rollout of inference-kernel v2.1.3 ~08:12 UTC earlier. Telemetry shows KV cache invalidations around that time. Could be correlated.
Alex C: grabbing recent deploy logs: `kubectl get pods -l app=hosted-inference -o wide --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp`
Alex C: paste logs snippet:
```
2026-04-21T08:11:59Z kernel-rollout: inference-kernel:v2.1.3 -> started
2026-04-21T08:12:12Z cache: evict prefix sync triggered
2026-04-21T08:12:14Z p95 latency jump from 0.45s -> 2.3s
2026-04-21T08:12:16Z 5xx count +48 in 1m
```
Mira S: confirming metrics in datadog: p95 and error rate spike aligned with that rollout. We should consider rollback or routing traffic to backup pool.
Priya N: decision needed: rollback vs traffic cutover. Rollback could take ~10m + warmup, cutover (route to dedicated fallback pool) might be faster if capacity exists. Cost vs time tradeoff.
Tony R: we have a dedicated fallback pool in us-west-2 with spare capacity ~30%. Routing can be done via runtime routing policy change: `redwoodctl route set --service hosted-inference --pool fallback-us-west-2`. Should be ~2-3m to propagate.
Alex C: starting runbook step 1 (collecting traces and kv-agg stats) — `curl -s http://metrics-api.internal/trace?service=hosted-inference&since=10m`
Mira S: while Alex collects, I'm preparing rollback plan for kernel v2.1.2 if routing is not instant.
PagerDuty: Escalation: secondary acknowledged at +2m. No further ACK from primary. Escalating to manager Priya N at +8m per policy.
Priya N: ACKing. I'll join the bridge in 2m. Link: https://zoom.redwood.com/bridge/INC-2026-0421-01
Emily K: FYI, customer-facing status page drafted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0421-01 (draft). I'll hold until we agree on mitigation.
Alex C: traces show heavy tail due to repeated KV cache misses for hot prefixes; seems like a small bug in eviction logic in v2.1.3. Workload causes cache thrash when some kernels start with fresh caches.
Tony R: ok pushing routing change now — pushing `redwoodctl route set --service hosted-inference --pool fallback-us-west-2 --propagate 180` (propagate timeout 180s).
Alex C: confirmed: route change accepted, 30s to first nodes.
IncidentBot: Route update: routing policy changed by Tony R. Propagation in progress.
Mira S: monitoring: p95 dropped from 2.3s -> 0.6s on the fallback nodes, error rate down 80% on routed traffic.
Emily K: notifying the three affected customers via the draft message; one customer responded: "Thanks — noticing improvement, please keep us posted."
Priya N: good. We'll hold on rollback for now — collect post-mortem data and prepare a patch for the eviction logic. Alex, Tony, please add timeline to the incident doc.
Alex C: adding a minimal timeline to the incident doc. Also: capturing exact commit id for v2.1.3: `commit 9f7a3b2`.
Mira S: I'll own the rollback PR if we need it. For RCA, we should check the kernel's cache sync codepath that runs at cold-start.
PagerDuty: Incident status changed to acknowledged (by Mira S). Manager escalation notified (Priya N acknowledged).
Tony R: follow-up action: throttle rollout windows to avoid simultaneous cache invalidation across all nodes, add jitter to eviction start times. Adding task to infra backlog.
Emily K: support action: sent status update to customers and created a follow-up for escalation to acct team for potential SLA impact.
Alex C: will stay on until post-mortem skeleton created. If anyone sees regression, ping me directly.
Priya N: thanks team. plan: stabilize -> collect logs/traces -> ship hotfix to eviction logic -> controlled rollout. Post-mortem scheduled 48h.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0421-01 update: status=mitigated (fallback routing) at 08:25 UTC. Bridge closed.
Emily K: closing support loop with customers; keeping the ticket open until hotfix deployed.
Alex C: final note: no data exfil, only transient request failures. tagging security as FYI.
Priya N: thanks everyone. Good coordination. :thumbsup:
